sources.title: 樣本／張量維度、置換均值、順序與物理時間的透明推導
sources.details:
sampling: N=1600, fs=16000 samples/s, duration=N/fs=0.1 s; concatenation N=3200, duration=0.2 s. Sample-time last index is 1599/fs; not an extra endpoint.
shapes: real one-sided STFT F=400//2+1=201; center=True gives T=1+3200//160=21. Bank [16,201] @ power [201,21] gives [16,21], T swaps to [21,16].
mean_invariance: For finite T>0, mu_j=(1/T) sum_{t=0}^{T-1} x[t,j]. For any permutation pi, sum_t x[pi(t),j]=sum_t x[t,j], so the exact-real mu is unchanged. Floating addition may differ in its last bits. This concerns features without order already encoded before pooling.
order_task: Take L=[1,0], H=[0,1]. [L,H] and [H,L] both average to [.5,.5] but the high-first label differs. Any deterministic downstream function seeing only this mean has the same input for both and cannot distinguish their order.
presence_exercise: Under the restricted illustrative family [L,L] versus [L,H], means [1,0] versus [.5,.5] can distinguish whether H occurred. This is possibility, not a general detector or learned accuracy result.
order_vs_time: Ordered indices [0,1] are compatible with physical anchors [100,200] ms and [1000,2000] ms. An order-preserving transformation t -> a*t+b with a>0 retains order but changes physical time. Knowing order alone does not identify elapsed milliseconds.
supervision: If the intended answer changes when order changes, the target objective must distinguish those cases to require using order. Suitable labels are a task requirement, not proof that optimization succeeds.
transcript_vs_answer: A string error can preserve information sufficient for a task answer, and two differently ordered syllable sequences can demand different transcripts. Therefore transcript matching and task answering require separate criteria.
